summary: Pence Lake Lookout Tower, Langlade County: named on a 1973 map printed 1977; FFLA lists it as gone. No build, staffing or site record found.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association county list reads Tower Gone, with no NHLR or FFLOS number.

events.note: Pastmaps describes a 1973 USGS map of Pearson, printed 1977, and says readers can locate the Pence Lake Lookout Tower on it as a landmark

evidence.supports: Pence Lake listed in Langlade County as Tower Gone, with no NHLR or FFLOS number
Pence Lake listed in Langlade County on the Forest Lookouts Wisconsin list
OpenStreetMap tags the structure as an observation tower
Pence Lake Lookout Tower named as a landmark to locate on the map

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No source gives a build date, design, height, staffing or site condition; the only fate evidence is the FFLA 'Tower Gone' line. The 1977 entry rests on a Pastmaps catalogue blurb for a USGS print, not on the map itself. The Pastmaps Wisconsin pages look like machine-written catalogue copy, so treat them only as weak evidence. FFLA (45.33055, -89.06361) and OSM (45.3305202, -89.0640023) coordinates differ by a few tens of metres. The DNR paragraph is statewide background and is not evidence about this tower. Not checked: the Langlade County Historical Society archive and the Wisconsin Historical Society records.
